The order of the backfill and the restart is not written anywhere. `Sessions.relocate` (`Sessions.js` load) repoints `sessions.json` only when Servex starts. If Servex restarts before the backfill, a session resumed within the hour appends to its old `s.file` and re-creates the old file next to the moved one. Write the order into the task log and into `ext/Session/doc/sessions.md`: merge, then the backfill with `--apply`, then `restart_servex`.

`public/framework/ai/sessions/files.jsonl:434-443` and `public/framework/ai/sessions/tasks/files.jsonl:477-480` add `"gone":true` for files that still exist (`sessions.json`, `week.json`, `index.jsonl`, `transcripts/`, four task `page.js` files). This is the worktree dev server's rewrite. Commit `08eee99df` says it reverted these, but they are still in the branch diff. Drop both hunks before the merge.

The decision line only says the shape was "relayed via mastermind-deputy". Requirements item 1 asks for that agreement.

But `roll_voice` (`AISessionIndex.mjs`, roll_voice) adds each child's `tree_usd`, and `tree_usd` already includes that child's own descendants. Either the doc or the code is wrong; check it on one real session.

`find_records` walks the whole of `public/`, the dated store included. So an old card session's `ai/v-*.jsonl` inside `ai/sessions/<day>/cards/<slug>/` would be moved out of its card folder. The comment at `Sessions.js:695-697` still says a card session's file "sits beside the card's page.jsonl". Check the dry-run manifest for card rows before applying.

Also `Sessions.js:322-325` nulls `backing.smart` when Claude refuses, which resets the session. The new brief and the new test (`Sessions.test.mjs`, `smart.system.preset`) talk of the "full Claude Code tool set" and "mastermind permissions". The test covers model, effort, permission mode and preset, but not the over-pace fallback to Sonnet. A second `check` that stubs `Usage.over_pace` to true would prove the "unless over pace" half of the ask.

A voice session's cost and child count drop back to $0 / 0 every time its own record grows. `schedule_record` (`AISessionIndex.mjs:117`) rebuilds the voice snapshot with `record_snap`, which always returns `children: 0, tree_usd: usd`. `set()` (`AISessionIndex.mjs:301-310`) then stores that, and `roll_voice` runs only when the *changed* snapshot's parent is a voice session, never for the voice session itself. The last write of a session is usually a chat line, so the list can end up showing $0 and no children. Fix: in `set()`, also call `this.roll_voice(snap.id)` when `snap.kind === "voice"`, and add a test that re-sets the voice snapshot after its children are in.

The ~01:55 ask is not written: `Servex/agents/session-smart.md` never names `mastermind-dictation-2`. The ask was that a dictation ask goes straight to `mastermind-dictation-2` with `send_to_agent`, and its "it's live, try it" comes back into the voice session. Add that bullet beside the `item` bullets (lines 3-9).

There is still a stale doc. `ext/Session/doc/sessions.md:90` ("Card sessions") says a card session's file is `/framework/ai/<card>/ai/<session>.jsonl`, beside the card's `page.jsonl`. The code now puts every voice session in the dated store (`Sessions.js:695`, `715`), and the backfill moves the 8 card records too (`session.jsonl`, decision 01:29). Reword it: `home` is the card folder, and the file is in the dated store.

Requirement 3's proof (a 1920 shot of `/framework/ai/sessions/` showing a dictated voice session, its cost and its children) is not in the task folder yet. `backfill-manifest.json` is still a dry run (`applied: false`, 61 rows, all `move`). Both come after the merge, and the order is recorded ("REMAINING STEPS", `session.jsonl` 01:29). This is in order, not a gap, but item 1 above will show up in that shot.

`Sessions.relocate` (`Sessions.js:417`) and `voice-backfill.mjs` `plan()` work out the day separately: one from `sessions.json`'s `s.at`, the other from line 1's `at` in the record. Both use local time, so they agree as long as those two `at` values match. If they ever differ near midnight, `relocate` finds no file and silently leaves `s.file` pointing at the old path. Spot-check one row of the manifest after `--apply`.
